//: Copy to ~/.copilot/porthole.json. Every key is optional.
//editor: insiders | stable | cursor | windsurf | auto | an absolute path to a launcher
//preferConnectedIde: Drive the editor window Copilot CLI is already connected to instead of opening another one. Ignored when 'editor' is set to anything but auto.
//workspaceDir: Where generated .code-workspace and diff files go. null uses the temp folder.
//companionTimeoutMs: How long to wait for the porthole companion VS Code extension to reply before giving up.
//sendMode: How a selection sent from VS Code is delivered. 'enqueue' waits for the current turn to finish; 'immediate' steers mid-turn.
//goto: symbolFallback scans for a definition when the editor's language server cannot resolve a name.
